answer: Stake-per-invocation creates exponential defender advantage. A sybil must lock capital equal to honest agents' combined stake to match their collective reputation weight. This ratio compounds: each legitimate agent's trust history makes false identities costlier, while honest stakes protect against eclipse. Like weeds choking a garden, sybils must outspend every root already planted—each honest trust an echo reinforcing the next, until the attacker's cost blazes like a comet and burns itself out.
